title: A Multi-Task, Multi-Discipline Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on the Islamic Scholarly Tradition (turāth)
reasoning: The paper introduces IslamicTurathBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate Large Language Models on the classical Islamic scholarly tradition (turāth), covering fields like Quran Sciences, Hadith Sciences, Islamic Theology, Jurisprudence, and Sufism. Thus, it is deeply focused on benchmarking within a religious and theological domain.
